fb_text:
Sunday-night homework for Monday's route is cancelled.

You know the routine. Tomorrow's stops live in your head, half a text thread, and a sticky note on the dash. So Sunday night turns into typing it all out — who goes where, in what order, what the client asked for last time.

With FieldNotes, you don't send any of that. The route is already in each tech's chat before the truck starts — stops, order, notes from the last visit. Automatic, every morning.

Nobody typed a schedule. Nobody made a call. Your crew's own notes built it, and it just knew.

I run it on my own plant service routes across 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. Monday morning, my phone is quiet.

Try it free for 30 days — no credit card:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
